correctness.rationale: Exhaustive centralizer module coordinates force a0=d=0 and a(t)^2+bc t^(n-1)=0. The leading-coefficient argument is characteristic-free; it reduces the reduced scheme to bc=0 (even n) or x^2+bc=0 (odd n). Both equations are geometrically reduced. The odd cone is irreducible and normal by codimension-two singular locus and hypersurface Cohen–Macaulayness. The rank proof uses valuation n-r and kernel in tR; the b column adds no rank, and rank 0/1 boundary is counted separately. Independent exhaustive checker outputs were replayed over prime fields and GF(4). The checkers corroborate but do not replace the uniform proof.

value.rationale: Rank-constrained loci inside irreducible nilpotent centralizers are natural representation varieties. This infinite unequal-block family displays a sharp parity transition between a pair of affine components and a normal integral quadric cone, together with complete finite-field ranks and counts. It isolates an analytically meaningful structural boundary in the first two-block unequal setting rather than repeating a known generic partition or a small numerical case.
